caption: The drawing is composed of black line work on an off-white or cream background, depicting five main objects and additional smaller details. At the top left, there is a circular plate or tray with a decorative, symmetrical border featuring ornate curves and floral elements. In the top center, a circular object shown from above displays concentric rings and markings within the center, including the text “D&H” and “No. 18.” At the top right, another circular object is illustrated from above, featuring a central floral rosette surrounded by a spiral, ridged pattern. Below these three, in the center of the drawing, is a side view of a bowl or tureen with a wide rim, curved vertical grooves along its body, and a pedestal base, topped with a domed lid. Along the bottom of the drawing, there is a sequence of small, scrolled brackets, each containing initials, numbers, or emblems, possibly indicating hallmarks or dates; these are labeled “to” in between each set of figures or letters. In the lower right corner, a signature reads “Lawrence Flynn.” The entire composition is monochromatic with precise, finely detailed black lines.
title: Silver Sugar Bowl
